typography.strategy: Massive, tight-tracking headings to create authority. Clean, highly legible body text.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous spacing (py-24 to py-32 for sections)
layout.grid: Bento-style grids for features with 1px borders and no soft shadows. Use sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-xl).

sections.name: Header
sections.requirements: Minimal header with 'Engage A.I.' logo/text on the left, and a small 'Book Demo' button on the right. Must be fixed/sticky with a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/50) and a 1px bottom border.

sections.name: Hero
sections.requirements: Centered layout with a massive H1 (text-5xl to text-6xl+ tracking-tighter) and a concise subheadline. Dual CTAs side-by-side. 'Call Demo Agent' should be the primary button (Solid Red). 'Book a Call' should be secondary (Outline or subtle white/gray). Background should have a subtle dark texture and a faint red glow behind the text.

sections.name: Stats
sections.requirements: High-impact typography. Focus on the pain points: '62% of small business calls go unanswered' and '$75B lost annually'. Use large numbers in red, with white description text. Layout can be a 2-column grid. Use the dark texture image as a very faint background overlay.

sections.name: Features Grid
sections.requirements: A 2x2 grid (or 1x4 on mobile) showing 4 features: Books appointments, Answers FAQs, Transfers calls, Captures leads. Dark cards (bg-[#0A0A0A]), 1px border (border-white/10). Include lucide-react icons in a primary-color tinted wrapper. Add a subtle hover effect (border color changes to red/30 or slight lift).

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.requirements: Centered block, very generous padding (py-32). Strong statement like 'Stop losing revenue to missed calls.' Repeat the two buttons identically to the Hero section.

hero_background.description: Abstract glowing voice wave. Use as a masked overlay or hero background image with low opacity (10-20%)

stats_texture.description: Subtle dark grit texture. Use in the Stats section background.

features_abstract.description: Abstract glowing sphere. Use as an accent image in the features section or final CTA.

photo_office.description: Man talking on phone at desk. Can be used in stats section if a human element is needed.

technical_instructions.styling: Use pure Tailwind CSS. Use arbitrary values for exact colors if needed (e.g., bg-[#FF3333]). Add standard HTML structure for sections. Ensure text remains perfectly legible (high contrast).
technical_instructions.animations: Use framer-motion for simple fade-up on scroll for sections. Keep it professional and performant.
technical_instructions.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. e.g., data-testid='hero-call-btn', data-testid='hero-book-btn', data-testid='stats-section'.
